_about: The home index: five instruments, in this order (David, 2026-10-28). build.py renders them into index.html; site.js only adds motion. Result lines marked draft are written from the project's body text and wait for David's sign-off.

tiles.name: anime pipeline
tiles.result: Blender previz in, finished anime shots out, from eight open models on one 12 GB GPU.
tiles.caption: meguri, shot M01: drag to compare previz and final. The camera track was smoothed after the first pass bounced on every step.
